items.title: AWS Quick updates: November 2026 (Changes from October 1 to November 9, 2026) | AWS Quick: Zero to Hero Updates
items.summary: Level 200. A handout for users and administrators on the AWS Quick changes from October 1 to November 9, 2026: five What's New posts and the AWS blogs. It starts with the name change of November 9 (Amazon Quick is now AWS Quick, and Amazon Quick Sight is now AWS Quick Sight). 1) Once an admin adds the desktop connector, everyone with the desktop app can sign in the same way as on the web. 2) Per-user AWS Quick Sight Readers move to Quick Essentials in stages, in Regions with Quick AI features. 3) Smart Approvals lets routine actions through on desktop and mobile, and is on by default (deny-by-default profiles must allow it). 4) Quick is now available in the Singapore Region. 5) Publish your PowerPoint and Word templates, and Quick creates presentations and documents to match. For admins, one figure shows what changes by default and how to limit it with custom permissions, Limit Profiles, and Always Ask for key actions. Screens of the desktop app show where users turn Smart Approvals on or off and how to open Brand assets. From the AWS blogs, it covers access from corporate networks through AWS PrivateLink, putting tables and documents in one space so an agent answers from both, and splitting an agent into parts. The appendix has the other October blog posts, a glossary, and sources. Based on the What's New posts, documentation, blogs, and pricing page public as of November 9, 2026 (the name change slide uses the product page and User Guide read on November 11). The update issue of the series AWS Quick: Zero to Hero.
